about: Val-des-Monts is a municipality in Quebec’s Outaouais region, in the Gatineau Hills north of Gatineau—not a city. Lakes, cottage country, and scattered villages such as Perkins and Saint-Pierre-de-Wakefield share a wooded Laurentian landscape popular with capital-region weekenders. About 13,000 people live in Val-des-Monts.
